root_motivation: WHO: Joe (PM) and the controller reading the PMF line; the chain's traffic gate. WHAT: they need a count of real external users they can act on. WHY NOT TODAY: `classify_source_class` returns `External` by elimination (state.rs:1066-1083) and `derive_origin` maps every non-synthetic class to `("external", detail or "external-unverified")` (state.rs:1093-1108; sole caller control.rs:454). The allowlist of what is "ours" (fleet IPs, synthetic header, loopback) was assumed complete; it was not, and it never can be, because fleet hosts move networks (carbon on public xfinitywifi since 10-20) and new scripts appear faster than the allowlist. CONSEQUENCE: 16 of the prod `external` signups on 10-20 are fleet traffic (G2 inventory: carbon + orch journals record no POST in that window; callers `~/.local/bin/fleet-post:23,:29`, `js_kind_live_probe.py:10,12`, `premise-sandbox.sh:18,:38`, orch `mcphost-js-kind-probe.py`); the PMF line is pinned to "0 confirmed real users" until the class is hon...
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a signup from a non-loopback, non-fleet IP with no `X-Mcphost-Synthetic` header, When the tenant row is written, Then `origin='unattributed'` and `origin_detail='no-positive-evidence'` and `tenants_by_origin.unattributed` in healthz rises by one.

Given an `unattributed` tenant, When its claim e-mail is verified (`owner_verified_at` set), Then `origin='external'`, `origin_detail='claimed-email'`, and exactly one `admin_audit` row `origin_promoted` (from, to, detail) exists even when two verifications race, because promotion is a single-row `UPDATE … WHERE origin='unattributed'` and the audit row is written only when it changed one row.

Given an `unattributed` tenant created at `created_unix` on UTC date D with no fleet-IP or header-stamped call in its history, When it makes an authenticated non-loopback, non-fleet, header-less call on UTC date D+1 or later and at least 21,600 s after `created_unix`, Then `origin='external'` with detail `returned:<days>` and the audit detail carries the source IP hash; a call 15 s after creation across UTC midnight, a fleet-IP call, a header-stamped call, or any tenant whose history holds on...

Given a `synthetic` tenant, When a claim is verified or a qualifying later-day call arrives, Then `origin` stays `synthetic`, no `origin_promoted` audit row is written, and `synthetic_promotion_refused` increments and is readable in healthz.

Given one seeded tenant per case (external+verified, external+later-day call only, external+same-day only, unclassified, synthetic+verified), When the migration runs, Then the verified row is `external`/`claimed-email`, both unverified external rows are `unattributed`/`legacy-external-unverified`, the unclassified row is `unattributed`/`legacy-unclassified`, the synthetic row is unchanged, no row is NULL, and the journaled before and after counts sum to the same total.

Given the deployed binary on an empty DB and on the seeded DB, When `/healthz`, `mcphost funnel --json`, admin `by_origin` and `scripts/ops/origin-counts.py` are read, Then all four report `tenants_by_origin`, `external_by_evidence`, `tenants_real`, `tenants_confirmed` and `origin_unknown` with identical keys (every key 0 on the empty DB), `tenants_real == tenants_by_origin.external`, `tenants_confirmed == external_by_evidence.claimed`, `origin_unknown == 0`, and the script's counts equal hea...

Given the single `Origin` enum, When the generated-contract test runs, Then the backfill value list, healthz keys and funnel keys are derived from `Origin::as_str` at compile time and the test fails if any surface lists a value the enum lacks or lacks one it has, while each migration's SQL remains a static string.

Given prod after deploy, When the operator runs `scripts/ops/origin-counts.py` on mcphost-1 as a counts-only ro read, Then it prints `external=<n> claimed=<a> returned=<b> unattributed=<u> synthetic=<s> unknown=0` with `n == a + b` and `n + u + s` equal to the pre-deploy tenant count in the run note (Live; evidence: the script run on mcphost-1 sourcing /etc/mcphost/env prints the six counts, pasted into the run note)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
